stories.title: Winless no more: Chargers hold off Ravens after forcing late fumble
stories.summary: The Chargers' defense stifles Baltimore's running backs, and Justin Herbert steps up in Los Angeles' first win.

stories.title: Sources: Patriots fear QB Maye has broken ankle, could miss rest of season
stories.summary: The Patriots are concerned that Drake Maye sustained a fractured ankle, sources told ESPN, an injury that could sideline the star QB for the rest of the season.

stories.title: Heat star Adebayo exits win over Rockets early with hip tightness
stories.summary: Heat star Bam Adebayo did not play in the second half of Monday's win over the Rockets due to hip tightness, but the team doesn't expect a long-term issue.

stories.title: Fulwiley not with Tigers after arrest as No. 9 LSU hosts Troy
stories.summary: LSU senior guard MiLaysia Fulwiley, who was arrested after allegedly attempting to flee a traffic stop, was not in the lineup or on the bench Monday night.

stories.title: Arch will participate in Texas senior day, says he's not thinking about future
stories.summary: Texas quarterback Arch Manning said Monday he will participate in Saturday's senior day ceremonies despite having one year of eligibility remaining.
